column1: # flow_ref 1 source=tests/spec/flow_semantics/slow_child_panics.onsa tests=9 evaluated=9 unavailable=0 skipped=0 waiting=0
@ the division of a tick of a child does not panic between the ticks, whatever the 0 that is stored
@ the division of a tick of a child panics at the tick that reads the 0, in the call that holds it
@ a call of 0 frames at the position of a tick does not evaluate the tick of the child
@ a call of 5 frames that holds the tick 4 panics at it
render slow_child_panics.via_child sr=0x41000000 params p=0 frames=5
@ the same call does not panic with 4 frames: the tick 4 is not in it
render slow_child_panics.via_child sr=0x41000000 params p=0 frames=4
@ a value that is not 0 is divided at each tick of the child
@ the tick of a grandchild panics in the call that holds it
render slow_child_panics.via_grandchild sr=0x41000000 params p=0 frames=5
@ the tick of a child in an arm that is not chosen panics too: the arm is run
render slow_child_panics.in_an_arm sr=0x41000000 params c=false p=0 frames=5
@ the child in an arm that is not chosen does not panic where its tick does not
render slow_child_panics.in_an_arm sr=0x41000000 params c=false p=0 frames=4
